SELECT count(*) AS n_lines, count(distinct (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_keys, count(distinct f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, sum(f.quantity) AS units, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(distinct f.etl_loaded_at) loads, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, count(*) lines, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(distinct f.sales_line_id) ids, count(distinct (f.receipt_id,f.line_no)) keys, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=107 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (cp.subcategory ILIKE '%clean%' OR p.subcategory ILIKE '%clean%')
GROUP BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH x AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) lines, count(distinct f.receipt_id) receipts, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(f.net_amount) net,
   sum(CASE WHEN p.subcategory='Cleaning Products' THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) clean_units
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=107 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT x.sale_date, d.is_trading_day, x.lines, x.receipts, r.receipts rpt_receipts, x.units, r.units_sold rpt_units, x.net, r.net_sales_before_returns rpt_net_before, x.clean_units
FROM x LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=x.sale_date AND r.store_id=107 LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=x.sale_date ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_name, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY 1, 2
